issues: PDF is a browser print of a Google Doc (created 2026-10-28, 'Version 1.0'), so text extraction has stray zero-width characters and some split letters (e.g. 'C ourse Catalog', ' ission') - Phase 2 should normalize. Catalog includes RU Middle School program (grades 7-8), PBL/CBL offerings for SY 26-27, and a Randolph Technical Career Center section (CTE, out of scope). Content-area graduation standards are in the catalog; separate Proficiency Handbook is undated (mentions a 2022 graduate). No 2025-26 catalog came up. Search-engine summary said the page links a 2022-23/2025-26 catalog - stale; the live page says 2026-2027.
